kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَرْجَل or حَرْجِل • (ḥarjal or ḥarjil) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Probably in comparison of the leaves to grasshoppers (below). As is well-known some such insects even disguise themselves as leaves.
g: Solenostemma oleifolium, Solenostemma argel, the monotypic genus Solenostemma

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَرْجَل or حُرْجُل • (ḥarjal or ḥurjul) (common plural حَرَاجِل (ḥarājil) or حَرَاجِلَة (ḥarājila))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: عَرْجَلة (ʕarjala) is also claimed to mean a numerous troop on feet. Distinctly a blend of رِجْل (rijl, “foot”) + عَجِل (ʕajil, “quick”). Compare also حَجَلَ (ḥajala, “to take leaps”).
عَرْجَلة (ʕarjala) is also claimed to mean a numerous troop on feet. Distinctly a blend of رِجْل (rijl, “foot”) + عَجِل (ʕajil, “quick”). Compare also حَجَلَ (ḥajala, “to take leaps”).
g: a troop of infantry, cavalry or horses or camels and the like (and a swarm of locust, after the word above)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَرْجَلَ • (ḥarjala) Iq (non-past يُحَرْجِلُ (yuḥarjilu), verbal noun حَرْجَلَة (ḥarjala))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: عَرْجَلة (ʕarjala) is also claimed to mean a numerous troop on feet. Distinctly a blend of رِجْل (rijl, “foot”) + عَجِل (ʕajil, “quick”). Compare also حَجَلَ (ḥajala, “to take leaps”).
g: to be quick or do in fast succession
